base=np.array([np.ones_like(P),P,P**2,P**3]).T
def sweep(name,fn,ks):
    best=(1,None)
    for k in ks:
        A=np.c_[base,fn(P,k)]
        co,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        e=np.mean((dP_dt-A@co)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if e<best[0]: best=(e,k,co)
    print(name,best[0],best[1],np.round(best[2],5) if best[2] is not None else None)
